علي بن الحسن بن علي بن فضال
أبي الحسن علي بن موسى الرضا

notes: Two sayings: al-Ridha's preface on the first letters (saying 1), and his own chain from his father to Ali for the letters' meanings (saying 2), each stored with its opening words
The second chain begins «ولقد حدثني أبي» spoken by al-Ridha, so his father, grandfather and Ali follow him as bare relations, with Ali a narrator after «عن»
